fragrances.name: Black Opium
fragrances.description: A dark, sugared coffee and vanilla gourmand with a lift of white flowers. Playful and sexy, it suits nights out.
cons: Can feel too sweet in heat

fragrances.name: Alien
fragrances.description: An intense jasmine sambac wrapped in soft cashmere woods and a warm, resinous white amber. Bold and unmistakable, it fills a room with very little effort.
pros: A little goes a long way

fragrances.name: Black Orchid
fragrances.description: Velvety and slightly earthy, with truffle, dark orchid and chocolate-laced patchouli. It has an opulent, gothic kind of glamour that belongs to the night.
cons: Too dense for daytime or heat

fragrances.name: Good Girl
fragrances.description: Tuberose and jasmine shaded with cocoa, roasted tonka and almond. It feels confident and a little two-faced in a good way, made for going out.

fragrances.name: Hypnotic Poison
fragrances.description: A trance-like cloud of bitter almond and dark vanilla with a thread of jasmine. Soft but seductive, it is a timeless after-dark gourmand.

fragrances.name: Flowerbomb
fragrances.description: A sugary burst of orchid, jasmine and rose around a patchouli core. Lush, glamorous and openly feminine.

fragrances.name: L'Interdit Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Tuberose, orange blossom and jasmine darkened by earthy patchouli and vetiver over a soft vanilla base. A moody, sensual floral that comes alive on nights out.

fragrances.name: Portrait of a Lady
fragrances.description: A huge, dark rose steeped in patchouli, spice and incense smoke. Regal and dramatic, it suits candlelit evenings.

fragrances.name: Shalimar
fragrances.description: The archetypal oriental, where sparkling bergamot melts into smoky, powdery vanilla and resins. Sophisticated and sensual, with a quiet sense of drama.

fragrances.name: La Nuit de L'Homme
fragrances.description: Smooth, seductive cardamom and lavender over soft cedar. It stays intimate and suave, which makes it a classic close-quarters date scent.

fragrances.name: Sauvage Elixir
fragrances.description: A dense, spice-heavy take on Sauvage, with cinnamon, lavender and licorice over ambery woods. Magnetic and built for cold nights.

fragrances.name: Ultra Male
fragrances.description: A louder, sweeter Le Male built around juicy pear and black vanilla. Playful and flirty, it is made for clubs and cold-weather parties.

fragrances.name: 1 Million
fragrances.description: Sweet cinnamon spice and leather in a gold-ingot bottle. Loud and flashy, it is unmistakably a nightclub scent.

fragrances.name: Dior Homme Intense
fragrances.description: A velvety, lipstick-like iris softened with pear and ambrette over cedar. Refined and romantic, it is quietly seductive at formal events.

fragrances.name: Luna Rossa Black
fragrances.description: Smooth coumarin and amber with a flash of bergamot and soft patchouli. Dark and polished, it is quietly sexy rather than loud.

fragrances.name: Eros
fragrances.description: Minty green apple over a sweet vanilla and tonka base. Brash and youthful, it comes into its own at clubs and parties.

fragrances.name: Layton
fragrances.description: Crisp apple and lavender melt into creamy vanilla and cardamom. A polished, crowd-pleasing niche scent for cool evenings and dinners.

fragrances.name: Interlude Man
fragrances.description: A swirling storm of incense smoke, oregano and resinous amber. Chaotic, powerful and deeply dramatic, it suits confident wearers.
cons: Too much for offices or heat

fragrances.name: Replica Jazz Club
fragrances.description: Rum, tobacco leaf and vanilla that call up a smoky late-night bar. Warm, relaxed and cosy rather than showy.

fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Intense Man
fragrances.description: Smoky birch and pineapple over musk, opening with a sharp burst of lemon. Bold and punchy, it performs far above its low price.

fragrances.name: Baccarat Rouge 540
fragrances.description: A bright, airy mix of saffron, jasmine and ambery woods with a burnt-sugar sheen. Instantly recognizable, it radiates from across the room.

fragrances.name: Grand Soir
fragrances.description: A plush, resin-rich amber built on labdanum, benzoin, tonka and vanilla. Smooth and enveloping rather than loud, it suits dressed-up winter evenings.

fragrances.name: Tobacco Vanille
fragrances.description: Honeyed tobacco leaf folded into vanilla, cocoa, tonka and dried fruit. Dense and enveloping, it feels like a slow winter evening beside a fireplace.

fragrances.name: Lost Cherry
fragrances.description: A boozy, juicy black cherry laced with bitter almond and liqueur over balsamic tonka. Flirtatious, indulgent and a little decadent.
cons: Can read as cough syrup to some

fragrances.name: Ombré Leather
fragrances.description: Supple leather dusted with cardamom and softened by jasmine over mossy amber. Rugged and confident, like a well-worn biker jacket.
cons: Leather can be intense up close

fragrances.name: Love, Don't Be Shy
fragrances.description: Fluffy toasted marshmallow and orange blossom over creamy vanilla. A sugary, flirtatious gourmand that clings to skin and radiates.

fragrances.name: Angels' Share
fragrances.description: A cognac-soaked pastry of cinnamon, praline and tonka on oak. Festive and warming, it is very hard to resist after dark in cold weather.

fragrances.name: Khamrah
fragrances.description: A sweet, spiced gourmand of cinnamon, dates and praline over vanilla and resins. Warm and dense, it is remarkably rich for the price.

fragrances.name: Black Afgano
fragrances.description: A dark, resinous haze of cannabis-like greenery, incense and agarwood. Mysterious and narcotic, it is not for the timid.
cons: Can feel oppressive in warm rooms
